evidence: The suggested fix is not applicable: find_task_run(pr_url, branch, repository) at products/tasks/backend/webhooks.py:29-33 has no team_ids parameter, so the judge did not read the callee. Every leg it runs is already keyed to the repository (task__repository__iexact at webhooks.py:41-43, 71-74, 85-88), so shadowing needs a run in another team carrying the identical output.pr_url for the same repo, which only team-scoped paths write: set_task_run_output via _get_visible_run(run_id, task_id, team_id) at products/tasks/backend/facade/api.py:2138-2151, and the tasks-webhook backstop _record_run_pr_url at webhooks.py:174-182 that fires only when a run's branch column equals the non-fork PR head ref. Self-driving implementation runs are created with branch=base_branch (products/signals/backend/auto_start.py:253) and nothing rewrites the branch column, so their branch never equals a PR head ref and the pr_url leg (deterministically ordered, webhooks.py:46-56) is the operative match; a GitHub PR URL is opened by exactly one run, so no second team's run holds it. The requested team is fixed by stamphog's unique (installation, repo) config (products/stamphog/backend/models.py:67-70, _resolve_repo_config oldest-wins), the other-team -> None behavior is the documented contract (api.py:490-496) covered by the other_team case in products/tasks/backend/tests/test_webhooks.py:1287-1319, and the caller rechecks team_id (products/stamphog/backend/tasks/tasks.py:196-200); a collision would fail closed (no automation), the safe direction for a gate.
notes: I would change my mind if a real write path stamped the same output.pr_url or the same branch string onto runs in two different teams for one repository (e.g. a cross-team task clone or PR-URL backfill).
